import { Component, Input } from '@angular/core'; /** * Shared dashboard sidebar for the authenticated company and job-seeker areas. * Active link highlighting is done with routerLinkActive, so no page needs * to hardcode class="active" anymore. */ @Component({ selector: 'app-sidebar', templateUrl: './sidebar.component.html', styleUrls: ['./sidebar.component.css'] }) export class SidebarComponent { variant: 'company' | 'seeker' | 'admin' = 'seeker'; ngOnInit(): void { const role = localStorage.getItem('role'); if (role === 'COMPANY') { this.variant = 'company'; } else if (role === 'JOBSEEKER') { this.variant = 'seeker'; } else if (role === 'ADMIN') { this.variant = 'admin'; } } }
